Definition: Jeiel, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeiel is the name of six Israelites, spread across the tribes and the centuries. He is the chief of Reuben's families, the father of Mattaniah whose son Jahaziel prophesied before Jehoshaphat, and one of the last sons of Adonikam who came up with Ezra.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps six men under one name, and each of them has his own place in the story. My position is that the name is common but the men are not, and God knows which Jeiel He means.
RelatedPeople: Jeiel, Prince of Reuben; Jeiel, Son of Mattaniah; Jeiel, of Adonikam's Sons
